pages.title: Casting
pages.text: The ring I am ready with answers when I call it, and I turn from ring to ring the way a swordsman shifts his grip.$(br2)A cast takes its essence from my reserve, then my vessels, and each ring needs its rest before it answers again. The spells grow with my carvings.

pages.title: The Spells
pages.text: The first tier is small: a bolt, a step through mist, a light, a bone spear. The second fills a book: shields, leaps, snares, a pocket into my ender chest. The third is the rift itself. Chains, a meteor, a gate, a black hole that swallows what it has broken, an anchor to come home to.
